7.2 Initialization and shutdown
[SWS_Mfx_00200]
Upstream requirements: SRS_LIBS_00002
⌈MFX library shall not require initialization phase. A Library function may be called at
the very first step of ECU initialization, e.g. even by the OS or EcuM, thus the library
shall be ready.⌋
[SWS_Mfx_00201]
Upstream requirements: SRS_LIBS_00003
⌈MFX library shall not require a shutdown operation phase.⌋
